title: Chipmunk native client API v1 (served by Actual Insights under /api/mobile/v1)
description: Every response body of the native client API. Money is integer minor units (cents). Dates are YYYY-MM-DD, months YYYY-MM. Strings are clipped by the server. Unknown properties are a contract violation (additionalProperties false everywhere) so a client can decode strictly.

me.description: GET /api/mobile/v1/me. Which scope this device token has, so the app can hide editing it cannot do.

groupId.description: The account group (as set up in Actual's sidebar) this account belongs to, or null.

investment.description: The user marked this as an investment account (stored by Actual Insights; Actual has no such type).

trend.description: Balance change over the last 30 days; only for investment accounts (null otherwise). flat when the change is within 0.5% of the starting balance.

accountsResponse.description: GET /accounts. Open visible accounts in Actual's own sidebar order (so account groups stay contiguous), on-budget first then off-budget, at most 100. groups lists the account groups in Actual's order with their summed balances; accounts reference them by groupId. Ungrouped accounts have groupId null.

balance.description: Sum of the group's visible accounts; null if any balance is unknown.

transfer.description: Moves money between two of the user's accounts. Has no category and cannot be categorized.

split.description: Parent of a split. Cannot be categorized here.

categoryGroup.description: Name of the category's group, null when uncategorized.

color.description: Effective colour of the transaction's category (explicit category colour, else its group's); null when uncategorized.

excluded.description: Left out of budget and spending figures in Chipmunk and Insights (not in Actual's own budget screen). Always true when hidden.

hidden.description: Hidden from transaction lists unless showHidden=1; implies excluded.

transactionsResponse.description: GET /transactions?account=<id>&group=<id>&category=<id>&uncategorized=1&limit=<1..100, default 50>&cursor=<opaque>. Newest first. account omitted = all accounts. group (a category group id) and category (a category id) filter by where the money went; at most one of uncategorized, group, category may be given (else 400). uncategorized=1 keeps only rows with no category that are not transfers and not split parents; off-budget accounts are never in the uncategorized view. uncategorizedCount is present on the first page only (same account filter). showHidden=1 includes hidden transactions (default excludes them and their counts); excluded transactions always appear, marked.

uncategorizedCount.description: Present on the first page (no cursor) only: how many rows uncategorized=1 would match for the same account filter.

categoriesResponse.description: GET /categories. Visible groups and categories in Actual's order, for pickers. Hidden ones are left out.

spent.description: Negative for money out, as Actual reports it.

toBudget.description: Null when Actual's API does not report it for this budget.

budgetMonthResponse.description: GET /budget/<YYYY-MM>. Expense groups only (income groups are left out), hidden ones left out.

transactionUpdateRequest.description: PATCH /transactions/<id> (write scope). Any of category (id or null to clear; not allowed on transfers or split parents), notes (string up to 500, or null to clear), cleared (boolean). At least one key. excluded and hidden are Insights flags (not Actual fields): hidden true implies excluded true; hidden false leaves excluded as it was; excluded false on a hidden transaction is 400.

budgetAmountRequest.description: PUT /budget/<YYYY-MM>/categories/<id>. Write scope. budgeted is cents, whole-number, within 0..1e12.

budgetMoveRequest.description: POST /budget/<YYYY-MM>/move. Write scope. Moves amount (cents, > 0) of budgeted money from one expense category to another in that month: from.budgeted -= amount, to.budgeted += amount.

budgetChangeResponse.description: Response to the two budget writes: the changed categories after the write (one for PUT, two for move: from then to) and the month totals.

reportCard.description: One dashboard card, already computed and shaped for a single column. The app renders each kind once; unknown kinds are shown as 'unsupported'.

chart.description: How to draw it. Absent means bars.

signed.description: When true the amounts are coloured by sign: positive green, negative red (account balances).

reportsResponse.description: GET /reports?report=<id>. Without report: the first dashboard page. With the id of a dashboard page: that page's cards. With the id of a saved custom report: a single card. Cards come in reading order, at most 40; a card that could not be computed is sent as kind 'unsupported'. Unknown report id is 404.

drill.description: Where tapping a row leads. level 'categories' needs categoryIds (a rollup such as a whole category group, at most 200 ids); level 'payees' needs categoryId; level 'transactions' needs categoryId and payeeId (payeeId '__none__' is the no-payee bucket). The app passes these to GET /spending unchanged.

spendingResponse.description: GET /spending?month=YYYY-MM&level=categories|payees|transactions plus the scope fields of the drill (categoryIds comma separated for categories; categoryId for payees; categoryId and payeeId for transactions). Spending is positive money out for the month. level categories returns one item per category in the rollup, level payees one per merchant for the category, level transactions the matching transactions (newest first, at most 100). items is empty at the transactions level, transactions is empty otherwise.

transactionDetail.description: One transaction with everything the detail screen shows.

reconciled.description: Locked by a reconciliation in Actual. Read only here.

importedPayee.description: The description the bank or SimpleFIN sent, before any payee rule renamed it. Null when entered by hand.

importedId.description: The import reference (for SimpleFIN a long id), for support questions.

recurring.description: Name of the schedule this transaction belongs to.

tags.description: Tags found in the notes (#tag), without the #.

transferAccountName.description: For transfers, the account on the other side.

color.description: Effective colour of the transaction's category (explicit category colour, else its group's); null when uncategorized.

excluded.description: Left out of budget and spending figures in Chipmunk and Insights (not in Actual's own budget screen). Always true when hidden.

hidden.description: Hidden from transaction lists unless showHidden=1; implies excluded.

transactionDetailResponse.description: GET /transactions/<id> and the response to PATCH /transactions/<id>: the transaction after any change.

reportListResponse.description: GET /report-list. Everything the Home menu can show: each dashboard page and each saved custom report. defaultId is the server's default (the first dashboard page); a device may pick its own.

transactionSplitRequest.description: PUT /transactions/<id>/splits (write scope). Replaces the transaction's split lines. 2 to 50 lines; every line has a category (visible, not income), a non-zero signed amount with the same sign as the transaction, and optional notes; the amounts must add up to the transaction amount exactly. Not allowed on transfers, reconciled transactions or closed accounts. DELETE /transactions/<id>/splits (no body) removes the split: the transaction becomes a normal one with no category. Both answer transactionDetailResponse.

budgetSeries.description: A repeating budget amount for one category. mode 'months' covers `months` months starting at startMonth; 'until' covers startMonth through untilMonth inclusive; 'indefinite' never ends (the server keeps the next 12 months filled). appliedThrough is the last month the server has written.

endMonth.description: Last covered month; null for indefinite.

budgetSeriesRequest.description: POST /budget-series (write scope). startMonth must be the current month or later (within 5 years). mode 'months' requires months (1..120) and no untilMonth; 'until' requires untilMonth (>= startMonth, at most 120 months after it) and no months; 'indefinite' takes neither. dryRun true changes nothing and answers budgetSeriesPreviewResponse. One series per category: a second POST for the same category is 409 conflict (use PUT).

budgetSeriesUpdateRequest.description: PUT /budget-series/<id> (write scope). Same fields as the create request without categoryId; replaces the definition and rewrites every covered month from the later of startMonth and the current month onward. Months before the current month are never touched.

budgetSeriesPreviewResponse.description: Dry run: the months a series would write, with the current budgeted amount (before) and the new one (after). Nothing is changed.

budgetSeriesResponse.description: Response to a created or updated series: the series and the months that were written (indefinite series report the months written so far).

colorKey.description: One of 12 fixed palette colours; the hex values per key (light and dark) are in shared/fixtures/palette.json and must match in every app.

colorsResponse.description: GET /colors (read scope): every category group and category with its effective colour, for the colour editor. PUT /colors/groups/<id> and PUT /colors/categories/<id> (write scope) take {"color": <colorKey>|null} (null returns to the automatic default) and answer okResponse.

explicit.description: True when the user picked this colour; false when it is the automatic default (group: by position; category: its group's colour).

percent.description: Whole percent change (12.5 = 12.5%); null when the starting balance was zero.

accountDetailResponse.description: GET /accounts/<id>?range=3m|6m|1y|all (default 1y). The account (same shape as in /accounts) and its balance history rebuilt from the account's transactions: chronological points, at most 400 (daily for recent weeks, thinner further back), the last point being today's balance. Unknown or hidden id is 404.

accountSettingsRequest.description: PUT /accounts/<id>/settings (write scope). Marks or unmarks an investment account. Answers okResponse.

categoryGroupCreateRequest.description: POST /category-groups (write scope). Creates an expense category group. name 1..200 characters after trimming; a duplicate name is 409 conflict.

categoryCreateRequest.description: POST /categories (write scope). Creates a category in a visible expense group (groupId); name 1..200 characters after trimming; a duplicate name in that group is 409 conflict. budgeted (cents, optional) sets this category's budgeted amount for the CURRENT month only; use Budget Config for a repeating series.

accountGroupCreateRequest.description: POST /account-groups (write scope). Creates one of Actual's account groups. name 1..200 characters after trimming; a duplicate name (any case) is 409 conflict. Answers accountGroupCreatedResponse. PATCH /account-groups/<id> takes the same body (renames; answers okResponse); DELETE /account-groups/<id> removes the group and leaves its accounts ungrouped (answers okResponse).

accountGroupAssignRequest.description: PUT /accounts/<id>/group (write scope). Puts the account in the group, or in none when groupId is null. An unknown account or group is 404. Answers okResponse.

transactionSuggestResponse.description: GET /transactions/suggest?q=<text>&limit=<1..25> (read scope). Typeahead for the Transactions search bar and the Merchant filter: merchants (payees that are not transfers) and categories whose name contains q (case-insensitive; names that START with q first, then alphabetical). q is 0..100 characters (empty lists alphabetically); limit defaults to 8 and applies to each list. Hidden categories are left out.
